subject: Workplace Skills
title: When to Stay and When to Go
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on When to Stay and When to Go.

hook.text: She stayed at the same company for seven years out of loyalty. The market moved on; her skills didn't.

buildup.text: Loyalty is valued but can work against you if the role stops growing you. Growth, not tenure, builds careers.

discovery.text: Ask yearly: am I still learning? Am I being challenged? Is there a clear path forward? Two no's means it's time.

twist.text: Sometimes staying is the right move if a promotion, big project, or reorg is coming. Timing the exit matters.

climax.text: Leave when learning stops, not when frustration peaks. Emotional exits lead to poor decisions.

punchline.text: Leave when learning stops. Not when frustration peaks.

quiz.question: What's the best signal that it's time to leave a job?
options: Learning has stopped and there's no clear growth path
A competitor offers slightly higher pay
